_note: Copied from the shipped TY 2026-27 timeline for W-146's synthetic pack, regime references renamed (NEW_TAX_REGIME -> SYN_DEFAULT, SYN_FLAT; FIRST_SCHEDULE_RATES -> SYN_CLASSIC); not law, never shipped. Original note: A long-term gain on land or building is charged under the provision that charges any long-term gain not on a listed equity — S2 s.197(1) (TY 2026-27, p.221) and 1961 s.112(1) (TY 2025-26, thc copy pp.462–463) — so it takes the part CG-PART-LONG-OTHER names (W-088g2, D-425). It carries no securities transaction tax condition: a transfer of land or building bears none, and a side whose charge breakdown records nothing reads UNKNOWN, which no NOT_PAID condition can meet (D-292, CapitalGainsStt). The cap on land or building acquired before 23-7-2024 — S2 s.197(3) and the substituted 1961 s.112(1)(a) second proviso — is not modelled here; it is W-088g. Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-18-capital-gains-basis.md rows 2, 4–9; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-31-land-building-cap.md rows 1, 5, 7, 9.
